text: {"lessons":["I repeatedly sold Stock A and Stock D after gains, so I should avoid taking profits automatically just because a position has risen; consider its prospects and my overall plan.","Frequent selling can leave me with less exposure if prices keep rising, and it does not guarantee the account will avoid losses, as the value fell in Period 2 and Period 5.","I should review my holdings and cash only periodically, make deliberate decisions based on the full account and price history, and avoid letting losses or gains alone dictate whether I hold or sell."]}
